summary: n8n is a Node.js workflow automation platform (TypeORM backend): users with roles and MFA, team/personal projects with RBAC membership, workflows (nodes/connections JSON, tags, folders, publish/history/versioning, activation), credentials (encrypted data, project sharing), variables, executions (status lifecycle, data, annotations), scheduled jobs/tasks, webhooks, secrets-provider connections, evaluation/test runs, and workflow review requests — all with REST CRUD over persisted entities.
